paragraphs.text: Pontotoc County Library will host a free Senior Citizen Craft Day at 10 a.m. Monday, Oct. 19, with lunch and supplies provided for participants.
Seniors will make decorative moth clips for the Halloween season, according to the library invitation shared by the Town of Ecru.
Spaces are limited. To sign up and reserve a place, call 662-489-3960 or stop by the library. The invitation does not list a reservation deadline.
